title: QCon San Francisco 2026
gist: This record is an InfoQ topic index page for QCon San Francisco 2026, listing headlines rather than an article; its only signal is that the conference's coverage is dominated by AI coding agents and agentic production systems.

insights.claim: InfoQ's QCon San Francisco 2026 coverage is dominated by AI agents in production, with sessions on building a $100M product at OpenAI, securing AI agents in production, Netflix retrofitting the SDLC for AI coding agents, and 'The Harness Is the New Operating System'.
insights.speaker: InfoQ
insights.so_what: Practitioner conference agendas confirm agentic engineering has moved from experimentation to production concerns.

insights.claim: QCon San Francisco 2026 also featured a session on the future of Apache Iceberg, indicating continued practitioner interest in open table formats alongside AI.
insights.speaker: InfoQ
insights.so_what: Open table formats remain an active data-infrastructure theme.
insights.locator: QCon San Francisco 2026: the Future of Apache Iceberg

insights.claim: QCon's 20th-anniversary conferences were previewed around production AI, resilience, and Staff+ engineering as headline themes.
insights.speaker: InfoQ
insights.so_what: Production AI and reliability are the framing priorities for senior engineering audiences.
